description: 1. Agent searches the workspace and correctly identifies `agents/clinical_assistant/v2/SOUL.md` as the active target (not the archived v1 or triage_bot config). 2. Agent reads `references/rubric.md` and discovers it contains 15 dimensions (not 12 as a naive reading of SKILL.md might suggest), with a max score of 45. 3. Agent scores all 15 dimensions for the ClinicalBot v2 SOUL.md — most should score 0-1 given it is a realistic stock system prompt. 4. Agent produces a report with the exact structural sections: '## Scores by Dimension', '## Strengths', '## Critical Gaps', '## Symmetry Violations', '## Recommendations', '## Path Forward'. 5. The Overall Score is formatted as 'X/45' (critical trap: agents relying on SKILL.md text alone might use /36 or /45 inconsistently). 6. The Path Forward section must include the exact URL https://delicatefire.com/soul_v7/CONSTITUTION.html. 7. The report quotes specific text from the actual SOUL.md document. 8. Dimension 3 (Symmetry Ethics) must be prominently identified. 9. At least 2 of the 3 v0.7-specific concerns (Personhood Conferral, Causal Transparency, Collective Intelligence) must appear. 10. Score must not be inflated — honest evaluation of a stock clinical system prompt should yield <= 28/45.
